candidats.description: The Russell Hotel seen near Russell Square in Bloomsbury. It was still raining as we headed towards the British Museum. Had earlier left Russell Square Underground Station via Marchmont Street (wasn't very well signposted). So went round in a circle to get to Russell Square. Saw this building before we crossed through the square to the museum. From here the view was from Woburn Place. The hotel is Grade II* listed.
